7d19956483e2650637d8ff48e151af2f529a04c9: La Berra is a modest-sized, low-key resort: 25 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. La Berra's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. La Berra's modest altitude, with the base at 1040 m and the summit at 1636 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside that window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. Budgeting for a stay at La Berra is clearly on the higher side: a 52€ day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. That is the price of excellence, but it is worth being aware of it before you set off. In short: La Berra doesn't rival the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
